sentences.text: Your barometer and the sky give early warning.
A falling barometer signals an approaching low or front, and a rapid fall means strong wind is coming soon.
A rising barometer means improving weather.
High, thin cirrus clouds that thicken and lower over several hours often mean a warm front is approaching.
Towering cumulus clouds that grow into anvil-topped cumulonimbus mean thunderstorms.
And remember Buys Ballot’s law: in the Northern Hemisphere, stand with your back to the wind and low pressure is on your left.
